## Week 1: Graph and Azure foundations

- [Microsoft Automation](../../training/ms-automation-foundations.md) (Learning path, 4 modules, about 3 hr 8 min). Four modules on calling Microsoft Graph and Azure Resource Manager from scripts: endpoints, sign-in without a secret, permissions and paging, then read-only checks for Entra ID, Intune and Azure Arc on fixtures and in a test tenant.

*Milestone 1: about 3 hr 8 min.*

## Week 2: the attribute-driven migration

- [Book 19 — Building the Attribute-Driven Migration](../../books/b19-developer-workbook/index.md) (Developer workbook, 10 chapters, about 7 hr 18 min). Why the Attribute-Driven Migration needs code with tests, not only runbooks: the HR middleware, Graph clients for GCC, validation kit checks, dynamic rules as code, Lifecycle Workflows extensions, Group Policy and machine configuration….
- [Labs: Building the Attribute-Driven Migration (Book 19)](../../training/labs.md#adm) (Lab, 18 labs). 18 hands-on labs across 9 chapters or modules: Lab 1 runs on the kit's fixtures with no tenant, Lab 2 in a test tenant. Building the Attribute-Driven Migration (Book 19).

*Milestone 2: about 7 hr 18 min.*

## Week 3: identity workbooks

- [Building HR-Driven Identity](../../project-plans/developer-workbooks/hr-driven-identity/index.md) (Developer workbook, 8 chapters, about 5 hr 5 min). A developer workbook for the Identity Lifecycle & Provisioning project.
- [Building Privileged Access](../../project-plans/developer-workbooks/privileged-access/index.md) (Developer workbook, 9 chapters, about 7 hr 32 min). A developer workbook for the Privileged Access & Administrative Identity project.

*Milestone 3: about 12 hr 37 min.*

## Week 4: Ticket-to-Machine

- [Building Ticket-to-Machine](../../project-plans/developer-workbooks/ticket-to-machine/index.md) (Developer workbook, 9 chapters, about 5 hr 23 min). A developer workbook for the Ticket-to-Machine loop on ServiceNow and SailPoint.
- [Labs: Building Ticket-to-Machine](../../training/labs.md#ttm) (Lab, 16 labs). 16 hands-on labs across 8 chapters or modules: Lab 1 runs on the kit's fixtures with no tenant, Lab 2 in a test tenant. Building Ticket-to-Machine.

*Milestone 4: about 5 hr 23 min.*

**Whole plan:** about 28 hr 26 min of reading and video, plus the labs.
